title: PS4 Startup
blurb: Smooth, warm and entirely without menace, the PlayStation 4's boot chime says the evening's plans are now formally settled. It has none of the ominous drama of the original PS1 sequence — Sony had moved from announcing a new era to reassuring you the machine was ready — but it makes up for that in sheer polish. For anyone who bought one at launch in 2013, it is already a nostalgia sound. Play it when settling in for something you have no intention of leaving early, whatever you may have told people.
origin: The boot sound from the PlayStation 4 (Sony, 2013).
